summary: User redesign of the MPI-362 composite after using it: instead of a blind Add/Subtract modal gated on one entry already carrying a mask, selecting two entries should overlay the first over the second on the canvas and give a brush/eraser pair - the eraser removes the top image to reveal the one under it, the brush paints it back. Proposed shape: the erase layer IS a mask, so Apply reuses the existing full-res /project/composite-media route untouched and the only new code is the live two-image preview.
